recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.effect: Apply the response the playbook recommends for the detected family.

block_source.title: Block source
block_source.effect: Firewall drops every flow from each detected source.

rate_limit.title: Rate limit
rate_limit.effect: Each detected source keeps only 20% of its flows.

isolate_host.title: Isolate target
isolate_host.effect: Cut the target server off the network until the attack stops (5 s quiet).

monitor_only.title: Monitor only
monitor_only.effect: No control change; the attack continues and is only watched.

increase_inspection.title: Increase inspection
increase_inspection.effect: Use both detectors and alert on a single hit; no blocking.

port_scan.name: Port scanning
port_scan.research_focus: Early detection, false positives, feature importance
port_scan.description: An external host sweeps the web server's ports. Cheap for the server, but it precedes exploitation.

host_discovery.name: Host / service discovery
host_discovery.description: A slow, low-rate probe looking for live hosts and services — designed to stay under alert thresholds.

brute_force.name: Controlled brute force
brute_force.description: Password guessing against FTP/SSH services after a short reconnaissance phase.

dos.name: Controlled DoS
dos.description: A single host floods the web server with slow and expensive HTTP requests.

ddos.name: Multi-source load (DDoS)
ddos.description: Four external sources flood the web server at once; each must be detected separately.

web_burst.name: Suspicious request burst
web_burst.research_focus: Rate / flow analysis of application attacks
web_burst.description: Bursts of SQL-injection, XSS and web brute-force requests against the web application.

bot_beacon.name: Beacon-style periodic traffic
bot_beacon.description: An infected internal workstation calls home to its command-and-control server at regular intervals.

zero_day.name: Zero-day intrusion (never-seen families)
zero_day.research_focus: Open-set detection of attack families absent from training
zero_day.description: Infiltration and Heartbleed traffic that neither detector was trained on, hidden in normal traffic.

apt_campaign.name: Multi-stage campaign
apt_campaign.description: Scan → brute force → web exploitation → botnet command-and-control from one actor.
